capacity_and_recovery.requirement: Measure ramp, saturation, maximum success throughput under equal error/p99 limits and post-saturation recovery.

cpu_memory_latency_throughput.requirement: Report complete client/service CPU, memory, latency, throughput, allocation and operation-ledger metrics for all cells.

optimization_stop_basis.requirement: Bind every kept/rejected optimization to measured evidence, correct semantics, bounded resources, gaps and stopping reasons.

package_aot_and_dto_reuse.requirement: Independently consume each exact candidate by outside-source PackageReference Native AOT, with ordinary DTO-only native reuse.

api_and_selected_ci.requirement: Preserve public API/Db names and pass dependency-selected correctness, short allocation, packed API/XML and package gates.

independent_review.requirement: Obtain scoped non-author review with truthful authorship/source/measurement limits and resolve findings.

final_report_reproduction.requirement: Publish absolute before/after values, deltas, native gaps, all eight cells, raw sources and executed reproduction commands; disclose unmet/unproven paths.
